protocol.operator: Unweighted counted public A;full thin SVD with standard singular-value rank tolerance
protocol.metric: Squared Euclidean path error / squared true flow norm;orthogonal components add exactly
protocol.scope: Own simulated truth only. L2 diagnostic is not official L1 S_od or actual hidden recovery.

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights

source.peak_scope: current process lifetime, not isolated per model
source.source_fingerprint_scope: On-disk source at evidence() call; a captured start archive is primary when present

limitations: No path is declared individually identifiable from rank. Counts are noisy and priors choose nullspace directions. Squared L2 geometry does not decompose official L1 score gains. Deployment aliases are excluded. Failure cases have no prediction and remain failures in original study;subspace averages are successful-case diagnostics only.
